evidence.quote: 15/01/2018 - Shanghai-based, Ctrip, one of the largest online travel agencies in the world, is using ICTS Europe Systems’ TravelDoc solution for the verification of passenger travel documents.
ICTS Europe Systems, ICTS Europe’s technological arm, has introduced Eagle to Namibia Airports Company, a state-owned enterprise and owner of eight airports nationally.
DiagNose has started operations at the Israeli seaport of Ashdod, screening incoming cargo containers on behalf of the Israeli Customs Authority using our RASCargO™ solution.
It is commercially available at various European and South African airports and is regularly used by leading airlines and freight forwarders, among them Air France and DHL.
